name: Create/Update a product
description: Create/Update a product. Create a new ecommerce product or update an existing one, identified by the mandatory `id` field. When `updateEnabled` is `false` (the default), the endpoint inserts a new product and returns `201`; if the product ID already exists, a `400` error is returned. When `updateEnabled` is `true`, the endpoint performs an upsert, returning `201` for a new product or `204` for an update. The `name` field is mandatory for creation but optional for…
